title: Target-aware chord and membership encoding
status_note: Proposed only; no runner/proof/experiment, lease/funding/task promotion or checkpoint scope approval.
question: Proposed construction: parameterize a line through the negative actual target by its slope, divide the factor-base polynomial by the residual intersection quadratic, and develop a complete algebraic collector including distinct, tangent, repeated-root, vertical and identity cases. The quartic/cubic starting formulation is a proof target, not a completed theorem or cost result.
decision_value: This proposal separates useful coefficient rank from root multiplicity and tests a different source-preserving encoding or collector. An exact coverage and cost contract will expose blocked setup, failures and representation effects before any gain is claimed. The current deliverable is a reviewable research plan; native code, proof, data and signed verdicts are future prerequisites.
